title: Grateful Dead Live at Nassau Coliseum on 1973-03-19

ai_review.summary: Soundboard tape of a typical 1973 Coliseum show with solid performance – Box of Rain and Loose Lucy shine – recording is good though some listeners note pitch‑speed quirks.
ai_review.review: The concert captures a mellow 1973 Dead night at the Nassau Coliseum, highlighted by a sweet Box of Rain, a gritty Loose Lucy, and heartfelt renditions of He's Gone (dedicated to Pigpen) and China Cat Sunflower. Reviewers generally praise the tape’s clear levels and instrument balance, but a few claim the playback speed sounds too fast, creating mixed feelings about the technical fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate 3‑5 stars and praise the musical set, especially specific songs; a few note speed/pitch issues that keep the overall score from higher levels.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and well‑balanced with near‑perfect instrument/vocal levels; some listeners perceive a slight speed/pitch anomaly, while others attribute tape decay to reduced high‑frequency presence.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A typical 1973 set featuring Europe ’72 material and a mellow vibe; only the second set is present, but it delivers solid transitions and memorable moments.

band_member_comments.Jerry: One reviewer likens the overall speed to chipmunks, implying his guitar sounds too high‑pitched; otherwise no specific praise.
band_member_comments.Phil: His vocal on Box of Rain is noted as surprisingly on‑key.
band_member_comments.Keys: Piano/guitar trading licks praised in the Box of Rain segment.
